contract.resultIdentity: Director immutable GUID RunId, last-paid ID persisted; repeated result/current run cannot pay twice after component/app recreation. UInt run counters are not persistence identity.
contract.rapidRetry: Retained terminal ResultRevision/LastRunSummary can settle after HasRunSummary clears in BeginRun.
contract.save: Two bounded PlayerPrefs banks CP1 with generation and checksum; highest valid generation recovered; invalid bytes preserved until an explicit later transaction uses a bank.
contract.writeFailure: Only successful Save confirms wallet/rank; failed bank memory restored, current profile unchanged; result retries after2unscaled seconds.
contract.nativeDiagnostics: Fresh in-memory profile; no PlayerPrefs Set/Save/Delete during sandbox; End/Disable restores real profile and ignores diagnostic terminal.

visuals.allocation: Prepared once atStart; enable/scale changes on upgrade; no per-frame or per-shot native resource allocation.

pendingRewards.selectionGuard: CanStartAnotherRun reserves an unseen valid current terminal receipt, so31captured+1unseen blocks another run before overwrite.
pendingRewards.storageLifetime: Unsaved FIFO lives in memory only; real diagnostic session rejects pending rewards. Normal UI cannot start another run when full.

contract.purchaseSafety: Requires live magazine/shooter/equipped definition, positive capacity benefit, no pending rewards, active focused Selection and affordable nonmaxed rank.
contract.equippedWeapon: Effective capacity/TTK/DPS prefer the magazine shooter current weapon over serialized menu fallback.

limits: Actual Unity Editor, native PlayerPrefs backend, graphics, device storage and frame profiling not executed by these standalone tests.
Local profile is not cloud synchronization or anti-cheat; checksum detects accidental corruption.
Only the current director-owned immutable terminal summary may be settled by the runtime component.
Unconfirmed pending rewards are in memory until persistence recovers; application/OS termination before a successful save cannot be recovered from this local-only MVP queue.
